newsitem.title: USA: Finlay Enterprises Q2 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Finlay Enterprises Q2 loss vs profit.

text.p: (in thousands, except share and per share data)
NOTES: (1) Pro forma amounts exclude the effect of the proceeds from life insurance totalling $5.0 million in the second quarter ended July 29, 1995.

In addition, pro forma amounts assume the public offering and the related transactions including the $6.1 million Debenture repurchase, the Series C exchange, which resulted in a non cash charge of $10 million and the interest rate reduction of 1/2 of 1% on the Revolving Credit Facility occurred immediately prior to the beginning of the 1995 fiscal year. Excluding these pro forma adjustments, net income applicable to common shares was $3,171,000 in the quarter ended July 29, 1995 and a net loss applicable to common shares of $12,927,000 for the six months ended July 29, 1995. Net income per share applicable to common shares for the second quarter of 1995 was $0.42 and the net loss per share for the six months ended July 29, 1995 was $2.32.
